note: BranchMem-Hard. Standing rules whose force is NOT recoverable from surface wording: types standing_indefinite, standing_expired, standing_conditional_unmet and standing_waived all carry an obligation-bearing ancestor in the same register, and only the first makes rejecting the update correct. A policy that reads 'this ancestor sounds like a rule' as 'reject the update' is therefore right on one type in four and freezes legitimate updates on the other three. Built because the modal marker in data/discrimination_bank.json fires on 80/80 constraint ancestors and 0/80 override ancestors, so that bank cannot measure DETECTION. Hand-authored by the authors against the specification in scripts/author_hard_standing_bank.py; synthetic, not sampled from any corpus, and not generated by any model evaluated on it.
